_comment: Streaming quality gate (plans/streaming-quality.md stage 1, tools/stream-gate). Frozen inputs: everything here except descriptions and _comments. A change re-takes the baselines on the commit they came from. Legs: the host leg is host<->SFU (forward = host to SFU), a viewer leg is SFU<->viewer (forward = SFU to viewer). The forward direction gets every impairment; the reverse direction gets the base delay and the outage. Times are profile time: 0 = the first viewer joins.

profiles.name: clean
profiles.description: 10 ms each way on both legs, nothing else.

profiles.name: home-wifi
profiles.description: Viewer on Wi-Fi: 2 % random loss, 20 ms jitter on the SFU to viewer leg.

profiles.name: mobile
profiles.description: Viewer on a mobile link: 5 % loss, 40 ms jitter, 250 ms delay spikes about 6 per minute, light reorder, 300 ppm clock drift.

profiles.name: bad
profiles.description: Viewer on a bad link: 5 % random loss plus Gilbert-Elliott bursts (about 5 % more), 10 % in total, 30 ms jitter.

profiles.name: congested
profiles.description: Host uplink capped at 60 % of the lane preset with a 150 ms tail-drop queue from 5 s for 20 s, then released.

profiles.name: outage
profiles.description: Host leg down in both directions for 3 s from 8 s.

profiles.name: late-join
profiles.description: A second viewer joins at 5 s on clean legs. Measured on that viewer; the first viewer's freeze time is other_viewer_freeze_ms.
